description: This is a test class for the HomePageService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods that retrieve default page paths for various modules and the homepage path, using mock objects to simulate dependencies.

classes.name: HomePageServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the HomePageService, testing various default path retrieval methods.

methods.name: testGetHomePagePath
methods.description: Tests that the getHomePagePath method returns the correct homepage URL based on the BasicUserRoleManager mock.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Tests that the getModuleDefaultPage method returns the correct default page for the 'admin' module.

methods.name: testGetTimeModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that the getTimeModuleDefaultPath method returns the correct default path for the Time module.

methods.name: testGetLeaveModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that the getLeaveModuleDefaultPath method returns the correct default path for the Leave module.

methods.name: testGetAdminModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that the getAdminModuleDefaultPath method returns the correct default path for the Admin module.

methods.name: testGetPimModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that the getPimModuleDefaultPath method returns the correct default path for the PIM module.

methods.name: testGetRecruitmentModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that the getRecruitmentModuleDefaultPath method returns the correct default path for the Recruitment module.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that the getPerformanceModuleDefaultPath method returns null when no default path is set for the Performance module.
